description: Rank caller-supplied RPC probe samples (freshness/error-rate/latency) through the exact deterministic rpc-health module. This tool performs no probe itself — supply already-collected samples keyed by endpoint id. An endpoint with no sample counts as down; all-down reports evidence: UNAVAILABLE rather than a fabricated best endpoint.

samples.description: Map of endpoint id -> { blockNumber, chainId, timestampMs } or { ok: false, error }.

name: launch_radar_rpc_health
